entities.summary: His Excellency, The Most Reverend, Monsignor. Franciscus Nipa is an Indonesian prelate of the Catholic Church and academician. He was appointed as the Coadjutor Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Makassar on 21 October 2023. He has been the Metropolitan Archbishop of Makassar since 17 October 2024.
